CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.statistics_bump(p_business uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  insert into public.business_statistics_state(business_id)
  select p_business where exists(select 1 from public.businesses where id=p_business)
  on conflict(business_id) do update set revision=public.business_statistics_state.revision+1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.statistics_can_read(p_business uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists(select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id=auth.uid() and p.business_id=p_business and p.role in ('owner','manager','admin'));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.statistics_local_cutoff(p_date date, p_time time without time zone, p_timezone text)
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  with wanted as (select p_date+p_time wall), samples as (
    select wall,t from wanted cross join lateral generate_series((wall at time zone 'UTC')-interval '36 hours',(wall at time zone 'UTC')+interval '36 hours',interval '6 hours') t),
  candidates as (select distinct (wall at time zone 'UTC')-((t at time zone p_timezone)-(t at time zone 'UTC')) candidate,wall from samples),
  valid as (select candidate from candidates where candidate at time zone p_timezone=wall)
  select case when count(*)=1 then min(candidate) end from valid;
$function$

functions.name: private.statistics_metric
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.statistics_metric(p_value text, p_known bigint, p_unknown bigint, p_reasons text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object('value',p_value,'knownCount',p_known,'unknownCount',p_unknown,
    'quality',case when p_unknown>0 then case when p_known>0 then 'partial' else 'unavailable' end when p_known=0 then 'empty' else 'exact' end,
    'reasons',to_jsonb(p_reasons));
$function$

functions.name: private.statistics_metrics
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.statistics_metrics(p_rows jsonb, p_historical bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'private'
AS $function$
  with agg as (select count(*) n,count(x->>'sales') ns,count(x->>'mainUnits') nu,
    sum((x->>'sales')::numeric) sales,sum((x->>'mainUnits')::bigint) units from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) x),
  reasons as (select case when p_historical>0 then array['missing_completion']::text[] else '{}'::text[] end dr,
    coalesce((select array_agg(distinct r) from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) x cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements_text(x->'reasons') r),'{}'::text[]) all_reasons)
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'completedOrders',private.statistics_metric(case when n>0 or p_historical=0 then n::text end,n,p_historical,dr),
    'sales',private.statistics_metric(case when ns>0 then round(sales,2)::text when n=0 and p_historical=0 then '0.00' end,ns,n-ns+p_historical,all_reasons||dr),
    'mainUnits',private.statistics_metric(case when nu>0 then units::text when n=0 and p_historical=0 then '0' end,nu,n-nu+p_historical,all_reasons||dr),
    'averageTicket',private.statistics_metric(case when n>0 and ns=n and p_historical=0 then round(sales/n,2)::text end,ns,n-ns+p_historical,all_reasons||dr)
      ||jsonb_build_object('quality',case when n=0 and p_historical=0 then 'empty' when n>0 and ns=n and p_historical=0 then 'exact' else 'unavailable' end))
  from agg cross join reasons;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.statistics_source_digest(p_items jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select md5(coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',x->'line_key','parent',x->'parent_line_key','kind',x->'item_kind','quantity',x->'quantity','price',x->'unit_price','identity',x->'product_identity') order by x->>'line_key'),'[]'::jsonb)::text)
  from jsonb_array_elements(p_items) x;
$function$

functions.name: private.statistics_source_items
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.statistics_source_items(p_order uuid, p_business uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'line_key',i.id,'parent_line_key',i.parent_order_item_id,'item_kind',i.item_kind,
    'quantity',i.quantity,'unit_price',i.unit_price,'gross',i.quantity*i.unit_price,
    'product_identity',coalesce(s.product_identity,case when p.business_id=p_business then i.product_id end),
    'product_name',coalesce(s.product_name,i.product_name),'category_identity',s.category_identity,'category_name',s.category_name,
    'source_valid',(i.product_id is null or p.business_id=p_business) and
      (i.parent_order_item_id is null or exists(select 1 from public.order_items parent where parent.id=i.parent_order_item_id and parent.order_id=p_order and parent.item_kind='product'))
  ) order by i.id),'[]'::jsonb)
  from public.order_items i join public.orders o on o.id=i.order_id and o.business_id=p_business
  left join public.order_item_statistics_snapshots s on s.source_item_id=i.id and s.active and s.business_id=p_business
  left join public.products p on p.id=i.product_id where i.order_id=p_order and (current_user='postgres' or private.statistics_can_read(p_business));
$function$

functions.name: private.statistics_v1_series_delta
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.statistics_v1_series_delta(p_current jsonb, p_previous jsonb, p_aligned boolean, p_reason text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select case
    when not coalesce(p_aligned,false) or p_current is null or p_previous is null then
      jsonb_build_object('available',false,'reason',coalesce(p_reason,'missing_counterpart'),'absolute',null,'percentage',null,'percentageReason',null)
    when not coalesce(p_current->>'quality' in ('exact','empty'),false) or not coalesce(p_previous->>'quality' in ('exact','empty'),false) then
      jsonb_build_object('available',false,'reason','metric_quality','absolute',null,'percentage',null,'percentageReason',null)
    when p_current->>'value' is null or p_previous->>'value' is null then
      jsonb_build_object('available',false,'reason','empty_average','absolute',null,'percentage',null,'percentageReason',null)
    else jsonb_build_object('available',true,'reason',null,
      'absolute',round((p_current->>'value')::numeric-(p_previous->>'value')::numeric,2)::text,
      'percentage',case when (p_previous->>'value')::numeric<>0 then
        round(((p_current->>'value')::numeric-(p_previous->>'value')::numeric)*100/(p_previous->>'value')::numeric,2)::text end,
      'percentageReason',case when (p_previous->>'value')::numeric=0 then 'no_base' end)
    end;
$function$

functions.name: private.statistics_v1_series_instant
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.statistics_v1_series_instant(p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select case when isfinite(p_at) and extract(year from p_at at time zone 'UTC') between 1 and 9999
    then to_char(p_at at time zone 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') end;
$function$
